title: Late Fees on Invoiced Water Damage Mitigation Balances
content:
## Collections policy — Water Damage Mitigation late fees

The job must be in invoiced status when a late fee is charged. A late fee may post only after the grace period following the payment due date recorded at invoicing has fully passed. The grace period is counted in calendar days starting the day after the payment due date, and the first late fee may post on the day after the grace period's last day. A late fee is assessed at most once per calendar month fee period, at the late fee percentage of the balance due at assessment, with the late fee minimum as a floor, rounded to the cent, half up. No late fee posts on an insurance claim job while its linked claim file is in opened, estimate submitted or approved status and the suspension period counted from the invoice date has not ended. Once that suspension period ends, or the claim file is settled, denied, withdrawn or closed, late fees resume for the fee periods that follow; no late fee is ever back-dated to a suspended period. A job whose balance due is zero or negative is never charged a late fee.

## Amount
The late fee for a fee period is the higher of the tier's late fee minimum and the late fee percentage of the balance due at assessment rounded to the cent, half up.

Hypothetical figures (2 percent, minimum $20.00): a balance due of $640.00 gives 2 percent of $12.80, so the minimum of $20.00 is charged; a balance due of $1850.00 gives $37.00, which is charged.

## Grace period, both sides (hypothetical grace of 10 days)
The clock runs from the payment due date recorded on the job at invoicing. With a due date of June 10, the grace period runs from June 11 to June 20.
| Date | May the first late fee post? |
|---|---|
| June 20 (last grace day) | no |
| June 21 | yes |

## Claim-pending suspension
| Job and claim file | Suspension period from the invoice date | Late fee may post? |
|---|---|---|
| Insurance claim job; file opened, estimate submitted or approved | not ended | no |
| Insurance claim job; same file statuses | ended | yes, for the fee periods that follow |
| Insurance claim job; file settled, denied, withdrawn or closed | any | yes, for the fee periods that follow |
| Self-pay job | — | the suspension does not concern it |

No fee is ever back-dated to a suspended period, and a balance due of zero or less never draws a late fee.
